name: app-shater-admin-panel-country-modal-and-tablet-hero
title: Shater control panel: tablet hero with a country-selector modal and a grid of admin sub-screens
whatItIs: A light page with a big orange-and-navy 'لوحة التحكم' title, a tablet held in a hand showing the dashboard, and a grid of six framed admin screens including a new-admin form, a country-selection modal with flag radio buttons, a delete-confirmation dialog and further dashboard variants.
whatItMeans: Detail-oriented; surfacing modals and edge-case dialogs shows the admin panel was designed beyond the happy path.
techniques: Include modals and dialogs, not just base screens.
Use flag radio buttons for a country selector.
Frame every admin screen in a consistent outlined card.

vocabulary.definition: A dialog that appears over the current screen and blocks interaction.
A control for picking exactly one option from a list.
